verse.verse_5: and by the lofty vault of the sky,
verse.verse_7: the punishment of your Lord shall certainly come to pass,
verse.verse_8: there is no one who could avert it,
verse.verse_9: on the Day when the skies are convulsed,
verse.verse_10: and the mountains shudder and shake.
verse.verse_11: Woe on that Day to those who deny the truth,
verse.verse_12: who divert themselves with idle chatter:
verse.verse_13: on that Day they shall be ruthlessly thrust into the Fire of Hell.
verse.verse_14: This is the fire which you used to deny.
verse.verse_15: Is this magic or do you not see?
verse.verse_16: Now enter it. Whether you behave patiently or impatiently will make no difference: you are only being repaid for what you have done.
verse.verse_17: Truly, the God-fearing will dwell [on that Day] in gardens and in bliss,
verse.verse_18: rejoicing in whatever their Lord has given them. Their Lord has saved them from the torment of the Fire,
verse.verse_19: "Eat and drink with good cheer as a reward for your good deeds,"
verse.verse_20: reclining on couches arranged in rows. And We shall wed them to fair maidens with large beautiful eyes.
verse.verse_21: To those who have attained to faith We shall unite their offspring who have also followed them in faith, and We shall not let any of their good deeds go unrewarded; every human being is a pledge for whatever he has earned.
verse.verse_22: We shall provide them in abundance with such fruit and meat as they desire.
verse.verse_23: There, they shall pass from hand to hand a cup which does not lead to any idle talk or sin.
verse.verse_24: They will be waited upon by immortal youths, like pearls hidden in their shells.
verse.verse_25: They will converse with one another, putting questions to each other,
verse.verse_26: "Before this, when we were among our families, we were full of fear of God's displeasure --
verse.verse_27: God has been gracious to us and has saved us from the torment of Hell's intense heat --
verse.verse_28: before this, we used to pray to Him. Surely, He is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
verse.verse_29: Therefore continue to give warning, for by the grace of your Lord, you are not a soothsayer or a madman.
verse.verse_30: If they say, "He is but a poet; we are waiting for some misfortune to befall him,"
verse.verse_31: say [to them], "Wait then: I too am waiting along with you!" --
verse.verse_32: is it their minds that prompt them [to say] this, or are they merely insolent people?
verse.verse_33: Or do they say, "He has invented it himself"? Indeed, they are not willing to believe.
verse.verse_34: Let them produce a scripture like it, if what they say is true.
verse.verse_35: Were they created out of nothing, or are they their own creators?
verse.verse_36: Did they create the heavens and the earth? No! They have no faith.
verse.verse_37: Do they own the treasures of your Lord, or have they been given charge of them?
verse.verse_38: Have they a ladder up to heaven by means of which they can overhear? Then let their listeners bring a clear proof.
verse.verse_39: Does God have daughters while you have sons?
verse.verse_40: Or do you ask them for a reward, so that they are over-burdened by debt?
verse.verse_41: Do they possess knowledge of the unseen, so that they can write it down?
verse.verse_42: Do they want to hatch some plot? Those who deny the truth will be the victims of the plot.
verse.verse_43: Or have they a god other than God? Exalted be God over what they ascribe as partners [to Him]!
verse.verse_44: If they should see a part of the heavens falling down, they would say, "A mass of clouds,"
verse.verse_45: so leave them alone till they face the Day on which they will be struck dumb,
verse.verse_46: the Day when none of their scheming will be of the least avail to them, and they will receive no succour.
verse.verse_47: Truly, for those who do wrong there is a punishment besides that, though most of them do not know it.
verse.verse_48: So wait patiently for the Judgement of your Lord -- you are certainly under Our watchful eye. And glorify and celebrate the praises of your Lord when you rise up [from your sleep].
verse.verse_49: Extol His glory at night, and at the setting of the stars.
